meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. The cubic's payers are a number. Time did not empty them.

lemmas.name: B15_stretch_budget
lemmas.statement: (ω·Sω)_+ on E_c is a readable stretching budget, with stretch-weighted |cos α_3|
lemmas.why: B14 subsampled efficiency. This write integrates the cubic's payers.

lemmas.name: B15a_cf_weights_budget
lemmas.statement: stretch-weighted |cos α_3| on E_c exceeds the unweighted mean by more than 0.15
lemmas.why: Constantin–Fefferman as a budget. The cubic pays more where vorticity meets extension. Not depletion of the field.

lemmas.name: B15b_majority_from_aligned
lemmas.statement: a majority of (ω·Sω)_+ on E_c comes from |cos α_3| > 0.8
lemmas.why: The aligned cap is a directional minority and a production majority. Median |cos α_3| is still ~1/2.

lemmas.name: B15c_run_not_depleted
lemmas.statement: a short viscous run depletes median |cos α_3| on E_c to ≤ 0.25
lemmas.why: Median stays near 1/2. Viscosity ate X. It did not rotate the sphere.

lemmas.name: B15d_run_keeps_aligned_budget
lemmas.statement: a short run drops the aligned share of (ω·Sω)_+ below 1/2
lemmas.why: frac_hi stays ~0.65. The cubic's payers did not leave. Tesla: time was a knob. It did not empty the cap.

lemmas.name: B15e_budget_not_X_a_priori
lemmas.statement: an aligned stretching budget closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Scored as B26. A weighted |cos α_3| is not an a priori. Time did not empty the cap. A share is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B15f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: weighting stretching by (ω·Sω)_+ is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. The budget is a knob on the estimate: a share you can miss.
